title: REST 成功信封 ApiResponse — v2
description: Unified success envelope (ResponseInterceptor; @Raw() skips it). v2 adds an **optional** `ordering` block, emitted only on reads that return ordered rows: which field decided the order, who controls that field, what happens on ties, and whether the position is covered by the hash chain. It is absent elsewhere on purpose — a field that is always present stops being read. Additive: not in `required`, so a v1-shaped envelope stays valid. Source: src/common/interfaces/api-response.interface.ts + src/common/interceptors/response.interceptor.ts + governance-shared/services/ordering.ts. / 统一成功响应信封。v2 加一个**可选**的 `ordering` 块，只在会返回有序行的读上出现：哪个字段决定了顺序、谁控制该字段、并列时怎么办、位置是否被哈希链覆盖。其他场合故意不出现 —— 一个永远存在的字段，最后就没人读了。**加性**：不进 `required`，故 v1 形态的信封仍然合法。

field.description: Primary sort field the query actually used. / 查询实际使用的首要排序字段。

controlledBy.description: Who supplies the value: the receiver (server-generated) or the producer (client-supplied). A producer-supplied field lets the producer choose a position. / 谁提供这个值：接收方（服务端生成）或产出方（客户端提供）。产出方提供的字段让产出方挑位置。

tiebreak.description: Secondary key when the primary ties; null means ties are unordered, so page membership is not deterministic. / 并列时的次序键；null 表示无序，页成员因此不确定。

attested.description: chain-order: the row's relative position is bound by the hash chain. none: the position is stored but not covered — changing it would not break the chain. / chain-order = 相对位置由哈希链绑定；none = 位置存着但未被覆盖，改了也不会断链。
